title: Sabri and the Unlit Lantern
logline: Sabri tries to give light to Zuhdi and learns you can only share a flame you carry.
story: Zuhdi, who was emptying of the false self, lived in fear of the dark, and Sabri, who carried patience, arrived with a grand offer of light. But Sabri's own lantern was cold, kept only for show. However many times Sabri pressed the dead lamp into Zuhdi's hands, no warmth would pass. Only when Sabri stopped to kindle a true flame within did the smallest glow leap, at last, from one wick to the other. Sabri learned that light is never given from an empty hand.
moral: You cannot give a light you have not first kindled within yourself.
